## Analysis Steps
### Prune VCF files further to check if selection scan can pick up any signals. 


```{bash eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# vcf files not in the repository are available at: OSF Storage: https://osf.io/wrca4 Data/vcf/

#file prep before running plink --indep
plink --vcf 3pops.MD2000_new.maf05.vcf.gz --set-missing-var-ids @:#[ph]\\$r,\\$a --make-bed --out 3pop plink --bfile 3pop --recode --tab --out 3pop 

#1. increase the r

plink --file 3pop --indep-pairwise 75'kb' 5 0.2 --out 3pop_75_5_0.2
#112982 of 351820 variants removed (238298 loci)

#2. Increase the window size
plink --file 3pop --indep-pairwise 200'kb' 5 0.2 --out 3pop_200_5_0.2
# 116171 of 351820 variants removed (235649 loci)

#2. Max pruning
plink --file 3pop --indep-pairwise 200'kb' 1 0.1 --out 3pop_200_1_0.1
# 170697 of 351820 variants removed (181123 loci)

```

### Using bcftools to subset the VCF file using prune.in file

### Convert VCF to the beagle format and run PCAnsgd

```{bash eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
### Using bcftools to subset the VCF file using prune.in file
bcftools index 3pops.MD2000_new.maf05.vcf.gz

bcftools view -R 3pop_75_5_0.2.prune.in.sites.txt 3pops.MD2000_new.maf05.vcf.gz > 3pops_pruned_75_5_0.2.vcf
bgzip 3pops_pruned_75_5_0.2.vcf


bcftools view -R 3pop_200_5_0.2.prune.in.sites.txt 3pops.MD2000_new.maf05.vcf.gz > 3pops_pruned_200_5_0.2.vcf
bgzip 3pops_pruned_200_5_0.2.vcf


bcftools view -R 3pop_200_1_0.1.prune.in.sites.txt 3pops.MD2000_new.maf05.vcf.gz > 3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1.vcf
bgzip 3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1.vcf

```

### Craete a slurm script file to create beagle files  
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

sink(paste0("../Scripts/create_beagle.sh"))
cat("#!/bin/bash -l\n")
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --job-name=beagle \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --mem=16G \n")) 
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --ntasks=8 \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --nodes=4 \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH -e =beagle.err  \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --time=72:00:00  \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH -p high  \n"))
cat("\n\n")
cat("module load vcftools")     
cat("\n\n")
    
for (i in 1:26){
    cat(paste0("vcftools --gzvcf /home/ktist/ph/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1.vcf.gz  --chr chr",i))
    cat(paste0(" --out /home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_c",i," --BEAGLE-PL \n"))
}

cat("\n")

#remove the head line and cat beagle files
for (i in 2:26){
    cat(paste0("sed -e '1, 1d' < /home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_c",i,".BEAGLE.PL > /home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_c",i,".2.BEAGLE.PL \n"))
}
cat("\n")

cat("cat /home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_c1.BEAGLE.PL ") 
for (i in 2:26){
    cat(paste0("/home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_c",i,".2.BEAGLE.PL "))
}
cat(paste0(" > /home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_BEAGLE.PL \n"))
cat("gzip /home/ktist/ph/beagle/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_BEAGLE.PL \n\n")

sink(NULL)
```

# PCAnsgd Selection scan
## File preps and running PCAngsd  
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Divide the BEAGLE.PL file into each population

# BEAGLE.PL.gz files available upon request
bea<-fread("~/Projects/PacHerring/plink/3pops_pruned_200_1_0.1_BEAGLE.PL") 
pop_info<-read.csv("../Data/Sample_metadata_892pops.csv")
pop_info<-pop_info[,c("Sample","Population.Year","pop","Year.Collected")]
colnames(pop_info)[4]<-"year"
pops<-unique(pop_info$Population.Year[grep("PWS|SS|TB",pop_info$Population.Year)])


# for each populations
pops3<-c("PWS","TB","SS")
for (i in 1:length(pops3)){
    colums<-grep(pops3[i], colnames(bea))
    vec<-c(1:3, colums)
    df<-bea[,..vec]
    write.table(df, file=gzfile(paste0("~/Projects/PacHerring/plink/", pops3[i],"_pruned_200_1_0.1.BEAGLE.PL.gz")), sep="\t", quote = F, row.names = FALSE )
}


y1<-c("PWS07","PWS17","PWS91","PWS96")
comb1<-t(combn(y1, 2))
y2<-c("TB06","TB17","TB91","TB96")
comb2<-t(combn(y2, 2))
y3<-c("SS06","SS17","SS96")
comb3<-t(combn(y3, 2))
comb4<-data.frame(V1=c("PWS07","PWS17","PWS91","PWS96","PWS07","PWS17","PWS96","SS06","SS17","SS96"), V2=c("TB06","TB17","TB91","TB96","SS06","SS17","SS96","TB06","TB17","TB96"))
comb<-rbind(comb1,comb2,comb3, comb4)

for (i in 1:nrow(comb)){
    pop1<-comb[i,1]
    pop2<-comb[i,2]
    col1<-grep(pop1, colnames(bea))
    col2<-grep(pop2, colnames(bea))
    vec<-c(1:3, col1, col2)
    df<-bea[,..vec]
    write.table(df, file=gzfile(paste0("~/Projects/PacHerring/plink/", pop1,"_",pop2,"_pruned_200_1_0.1.BEAGLE.PL.gz")), sep="\t", quote = F, row.names = FALSE )
}

# Create slurm scripts
bfiles<-list.files("~/Projects/PacHerring/plink/", pattern="BEAGLE.PL.gz")
# only select 1,2,4,11,15,16,17,22,23,25,28
sink("../Scripts/pcangsd_selection1.sh")
cat("#!/bin/bash -l")
cat("\n")
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --job-name=selection \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --mem=24G \n")) 
cat(paste0("#SBATCH --time=24:00:00  \n"))
cat(paste0("#SBATCH -p low  \n"))
cat("\n\n")
cat('export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"')
cat("\n\n")
for (i in c(1,2,4,11,15,16,17,22,23,25,28)){
  fname<-gsub("_pruned_200_1_0.1.BEAGLE.PL.gz",'', bfiles[i])
  cat(paste0("pcangsd --beagle  /home/ktist/ph/beagle/",bfiles[i], " --out /home/ktist/ph/",fname," --eig 2 --threads 64 --selection --sites-save \n"))
}

sink(NULL)
```

## Plot the results of each population 
### pruned at 200.1.01
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Selection scan results are available at: OSF Storage: https://osf.io/wrca4 Data/PCAngsd/selection/
# function for QQplot
qqchi<-function(x,...){
    lambda<-round(median(x)/qchisq(0.5,1),2)
    qqplot(qchisq((1:length(x)-0.5)/(length(x)),1),x,ylab="Observed",xlab="Expected",...);abline(0,1,col=2,lwd=2)
    legend("topleft",paste("lambda=",lambda))
}


pop_info<-read.csv("../Data/Sample_metadata_892pops.csv")
pop_info<-pop_info[,c("Sample","pop","Year.Collected")]
colnames(pop_info)[3]<-"year"

## make Manhattan plots

filenames<-list.files("../Data/PCAangsd/selection_highPruned_200.1.0.1/", pattern=".selection")
evens<-paste0("chr",seq(2,26, by=2))

pos<-read.table("~/Projects/PacHerring/plink/3pop_200_1_0.1.prune.in.sites.txt")
names(pos)<-c("chr","pos")

# Check QQ plot and lambda also
qqchi2<-function(x,...){
    lambda<-round(median(x)/qchisq(0.5,1),2)
    qqplot(qchisq((1:length(x)-0.5)/(length(x)),1),x,ylab="Observed",xlab="Expected", main=filen,...);abline(0,1,col=2,lwd=2)
    legend("topleft",paste("lambda=",lambda))
}

for (i in 1:length(filenames)){
    D1 <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0("../Data/PCAangsd/selection_highPruned_200.1.0.1/",filenames[i]))) 
    # Covert to p=values
    p <- pchisq(D1, 1, lower.tail=FALSE)
    pval<-data.frame(p[,1])
    names(pval)<-"pval"
    pval$loc<-1:nrow(pval)
    pval$pval.log<--log10(pval$pval)
    
    # loci used in the analysis 
    filen<-gsub(".selection",'',filenames[i])
    sites<-read.table(paste0("../Data/PCAangsd/selection_highPruned_200.1.0.1/",filen,".sites"))
    
    {png(paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/QQplot_200.1.01_",filen,".png"), width=5, height=5,units="in", res=300)
    qqchi2(D1[,1])
    dev.off()}
    
    # filter down to used loci only
    used.sites<-cbind(pos, sites)
    used.sites<-used.sites[used.sites$V1==1,]
    
    # Combine the locations and pvalues
    pval<-cbind(used.sites,pval)
    
    #calculate FDR
    pval$q <- p.adjust(pval$pval, method="BH")     # Benjamini–Hochberg FDR
    #count the number of sites per chromosomes
    poss<-data.frame(chr=paste0("chr",1:26))
    k=1
    for (j in 1:26){
        df<-pval[pval$chr==paste0("chr",j),]
        poss$start[j]<-k
        poss$end[j]<-k+nrow(df)-1
        k=k+nrow(df)
    }
    poss$x<-poss$start+(poss$end-poss$start)/2

    pval$color<-"steelblue"
    pval$color[pval$chr %in% evens]<-"lightblue"
    
    ggplot(data=pval, aes(x=loc, y=pval.log, color=color))+
        geom_point(size=0.1)+
        scale_color_manual(values=c("lightblue","steelblue"), guide='none')+
        scale_x_continuous(name="Chromosome position", breaks=poss$x, labels=1:26)+
        theme_classic()+ylab("-log10(p-value)")+
        geom_hline(yintercept =-log10(10^-5), color="red")+ #approximate pval cutoff
        ggtitle(paste0(filen,"_pruned_200_1_0.1"))
    ggsave(paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/",filen,"_pruned_200_1_0.1_selection_scan.png"), width=8, height=4,dpi=300)
           
    highloci<-pval[pval$pval<=0.00001,]
    write.csv(highloci, paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/",filen,"_pruned_200_1_0.1_selection.scan.sig.loci.csv"))
}

```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    ggplot(data=pval, aes(x=loc, y=q, color=color))+
        geom_point(size=0.1)+
        scale_color_manual(values=c("lightblue","steelblue"), guide='none')+
        scale_x_continuous(name="Chromosome position", breaks=poss$x, labels=1:26)+
        theme_classic()+ylab("FDR")+
        ggtitle(filen)
    
    highloci<-pval[pval$pval<=0.00001,]
    write.csv(highloci, paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/",filen,"_selection_scan.sig.loci.csv"))
}


# -log10(0.05/232644) #6.667722
###  Significant p-value for 232,644 loci is 6.67  ###
#-log10(0.05/nrow(pval)) = 6.585718
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
qqchi2<-function(x,...){
    lambda<-round(median(x)/qchisq(0.5,1),2)
    qqplot(qchisq((1:length(x)-0.5)/(length(x)),1),x,ylab="Observed",xlab="Expected", main=filen,...);abline(0,1,col=2,lwd=2)
    legend("topleft",paste("lambda=",lambda))}

## make Manhattan plots
filenames<-list.files("../Data/PCAangsd/selection_highPruned_75.5.0.2/", pattern=".selection")
evens<-paste0("chr",seq(2,26, by=2))

pos<-read.table("~/Projects/PacHerring/plink/3pop_75_5_0.2.prune.in.sites.txt")
names(pos)<-c("chr","pos")

for (i in 1:length(filenames)){
    D1 <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0("../Data/PCAangsd/selection_highPruned_75.5.0.2/",filenames[i]))) 
    # Covert to p=values
    p <- pchisq(D1, 1, lower.tail=FALSE)
    pval<-data.frame(p[,1])
    names(pval)<-"pval"
    pval$loc<-1:nrow(pval)
    pval$pval.log<--log10(pval$pval)
    
    # loci used in the analysis 
    filen<-gsub(".selection",'',filenames[i])
    sites<-read.table(paste0("../Data/PCAangsd/selection_highPruned_75.5.0.2/",filen,".sites"))
    
    {png(paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/QQplot_",filen,".png"), width=5, height=5,units="in", res=300)
    qqchi2(D1[,1])
    dev.off()}
    
    # filter down to used loci only
    used.sites<-cbind(pos, sites)
    used.sites<-used.sites[used.sites$V1==1,]
    
    # Combine the locations and pvalues
    pval<-cbind(used.sites,pval)
    
    #calculate FDR
    pval$q <- p.adjust(pval$pval, method="BH")     # Benjamini–Hochberg FDR
    #count the number of sites per chromosomes
    poss<-data.frame(chr=paste0("chr",1:26))
    k=1
    for (j in 1:26){
        df<-pval[pval$chr==paste0("chr",j),]
        poss$start[j]<-k
        poss$end[j]<-k+nrow(df)-1
        k=k+nrow(df)
    }
    poss$x<-poss$start+(poss$end-poss$start)/2

    pval$color<-"steelblue"
    pval$color[pval$chr %in% evens]<-"lightblue"
    
    ggplot(data=pval, aes(x=loc, y=pval.log, color=color))+
        geom_point(size=0.1)+
        scale_color_manual(values=c("lightblue","steelblue"), guide='none')+
        scale_x_continuous(name="Chromosome position", breaks=poss$x, labels=1:26)+
        theme_classic()+ylab("-log10(p-value)")+
        geom_hline(yintercept =-log10(10^-5), color="red")+ #approximate pval cutoff
        ggtitle(filen)
    ggsave(paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/",filen,"_selection_scan.png"), width=8, height=4,dpi=300)
           
    highloci<-pval[pval$pval<=0.00001,]
    write.csv(highloci, paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/",filen,"_selection_scan.sig.loci.csv"))
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

files<-list.files("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/", pattern="200_5_0.2_selection.scan.sig.loci.csv")

for (i in 1:length(files)){
    
    id<-gsub("_pruned_200_5_0.2_selection.scan.sig.loci.csv",'',files[i])
    df1<-read.csv(paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/", files[i]), row.names = 1)
    df2<-read.csv(paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/", id,"_pruned_200_1_0.1_selection.scan.sig.loci.csv"), row.names = 1)
    df1$prune<-"200_5_0.2"
    df2$prune<-"200_1_0.1"
    
    #any overlapping regions?
    df<-rbind(df2,df1)
    write.csv(df,paste0("../Output/PCA/selection_highlypruned/",id,"_selection_loci_comparison.csv"))
    
    print(id)
    print("Overlapping chromosome(s)")
    chr<-df1$chr %in% df2$chr
    print(chr)
    if (TRUE %in% chr){
        site<-df1$pos %in% df2$pos
        print("Overlapping position(s)")
        print(site)
    }
}
```
